findings.finding: The primary CDFA index explicitly labels the Caribbean fruit fly Long Beach proclamation March 18, 2026. This supplies indexed document-date provenance distinct from the prior filename-only lead.
findings.locator: Caribbean Fruit Fly > Los Angeles County > Proclamation of an Emergency Program

findings.finding: The report confirms four flies between June 30 and August 11, 2026 in Long Beach, but explicitly identifies Bactrocera dorsalis (Hendel) group.
findings.reason: The report describes a closely related group whose species are difficult to distinguish. Do not strip the group qualifier and automatically create exact Bactrocera dorsalis occurrence.

candidatePolicy: The two Caribbean fruit fly candidates remain unadmitted. The oriental fruit fly group report is retained as a taxonomy-adversarial example, not an added exact-species candidate.
nextAction: Independent source review for the two Anastrepha suspensa pairs and a tested official confirmed-occurrence report method. Preserve interval/year date precision; reject treatment-area, host-list, program-expiry, sterile-release and group-to-species transformations.
